content.comment_body: Hello, I'd like to use [product_name] with a simple operator panel similar to [product_name] or [product_name]. Is this possible, and if so, how can I do it? Thank you.
Hi! I believe your only option is to use the [product_name] TD, which is a specialized panel made solely for [product_name].
Are you certain this is the only solution? Is it not possible to use more generic panels like [product_name] or [product_name]?
It's not possible. [product_name] and [product_name] (by the way, [product_name] is no longer available) belong to a completely different product family.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants indicated uncertainty and dissatisfaction regarding limited operator panel compatibility with [product_name] systems. Users hoped to use more standard operator panels, but it was clarified that only the dedicated [product_name] operator device works with [product_name] controllers, which reduces flexibility and may inconvenience those who seek broader compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to be compatible with conventional operator panels, not just with the dedicated [product_name] TD panel.
